info.name: Naseej API (seed only — no deletes)
info.description: Creates seed + CRUD-lane data and leaves it in the database. No DELETE requests and no teardown folder. Run on empty DB (or expect duplicate-key errors on re-run). Same baseUrl variable as the main collection.
